user.title: MET Cloud Layers
user.description: Layered cloud-cover forecasts (low/mid/high) from MET Norway's free Locationforecast API. No API key needed.

data_description.latitude: Defaults to your Home Assistant location. Sent with 4 decimals (MET requirement).
data_description.longitude: Defaults to your Home Assistant location. Sent with 4 decimals (MET requirement).
data_description.altitude: Site elevation in metres; improves the forecast slightly.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the MET API.

init.title: MET Cloud Layers options
init.description: The weights set how much a full cover of each cloud layer attenuates solar irradiance in the transmittance/sky-quality sensors (0 = ignores the layer, 1 = blocks everything).

data_description.update_interval_minutes: MET refreshes the data roughly every 30 minutes; polling faster only yields cached answers.
